title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - CommunicationProtocol
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/CommunicationProtocol. A communication protocol, e.g. BLE, serial, Ethernet... (ttl rdfs:comment). subClassOf saref:FeatureKind, s4syst:Connection.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommunicationProtocol'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Open vocabulary (not a closed enum) naming the communication protocol. The source ttl declares 3 s4ehaw:CommunicationProtocol-typed named individuals: BluetoothLowEnergy, UltraWideBand, and one written 'IEEE802\-15\-6' in the ttl using Turtle PNAME hyphen-escaping, whose real unescaped label/value is 'IEEE802-15-6' (used verbatim, unescaped, in this model's example).
